correctness.rationale: Using fixed symmetric 12-vertex degree-five icosahedral adjacency, independent enumeration of all 2^12 vertex subsets by both two-colorability and odd-cycle test gives exactly 1,023 bipartite-induced nonempty faces, f-vector (12,66,200,345,300,100), minimal nonfaces 20 triangles + 12 five-cycles. Triangle-free supercomplex has 1,047 nonempty faces and precisely 12 free 5-/6-subset face pairs, giving elementary collapse T↘B. All 100 maximal 5-faces and 300 4-faces yield connected pure pseudomanifold with each ridge in exactly two facets and a negative signed dual holonomy loop proving nonorientability. Independent 510-pair Morse matching complete DAG on 1,023 nodes/4,212 incidences leaves critical cells dimensions 0,4,5; exact signed integer reduction yields 5→4 coefficient +2. Hence CW model S4∪degree2 e5 = M(Z/2,4) and H4=Z/2, without inferring integral homotopy from modular ranks alone.
